Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

She builds a bubble tower, has a dance party and even stands inside a giant bubble! Then, Meekah explores water science and physics through active play. She experiments with sounds at a water table, learns about levers by lifting a car and tinkers with small objects to build huge structures!

programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He and D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders

The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.desc: Get ready to welcome some new Magic Pets with Mila and Morphle! Then, they meet Slushyseal, who can change items into juice pops, but the friends have to stop him when he starts turning all the trees and flowers into frozen treats! From a pet that swaps bodies to one that hypnotizes animals, it's a day full of new and magical friends!

programme.title: Oddbods

programme.desc: Will your luck hold out this Adventurous August? Watch Pogo try to get a piece of Newt's four-leaf clover luck. Then, during a solar eclipse, help Bubbles solve the mystery of her disappearing friends. Is it aliens?

programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! programme.desc: The great dino-move to California continues, but the convoy is hit by a series of mysterious equipment malfunctions that bring their progress to a halt. It's a race against time to solve the strange breakdowns and get their precious prehistoric cargo back on the road to their new home.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The move to California continues as the Park Rangers get the new T-Rex Ranch ready for the dinosaurs! First, Park Ranger Aaron meets the new Park Ranger, Tara, who quickly joins in to help him with some messy dino doody duty. Then, with the help of another new ranger, Sophie, Aaron builds strong paddock fences around the new ranch to keep all the dinosaurs safe. But their task takes a turn when a raptor arrives, frantically searching for her missing baby egg!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Things are getting wild for the Oddbods! First, Bubbles is transformed into a bee-sized creature after an accident with one of her experiments. While facing the dangers of the world, she must get Newt's help to turn back to her normal self. Then, an incident with Fuse sends Jeff off the deep end, and he quickly descends into a feral state! Fuse and Newt must work together to rehabilitate their friend back to normality.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Your Adventurous August quest awaits! Help Newt save a lost bird egg from Fuse, who is tasked with chopping down its tree. Then, join Slick on a desperate and hilarious hunt for a Golden Ticket to an exclusive disco party!

programme.desc: Find the colors of Adventurous August! Join Meekah on a hunt to fill her Rainbow Bingo card at a fun play place. Then, learn all about her daily routines that help prepare for a day of adventure and a good night's sleep.

programme.desc: It's a grand Adventurous August finale! Join Meekah for a game of hide-and-seek in a museum, where she'll report the news. Then, team up with Blippi at a waterpark to follow a real treasure map to a hidden prize!

programme.desc: Blippi is exploring the wonders of Singapore! First, he visits Jewel Changi Airport to navigate a giant maze and see the massive indoor waterfall! Then, Blippi has fun exploring the beach and testing how fast he can go! He slides at Splash Tribe, conquers the huge HydroDash water obstacle course and rides a luge down a big hill. It's a Singapore adventure!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Answer the call of Adventurous August! Join Blippi on a camping trip to learn how to set up a tent and make tasty s'mores. Then, explore a park to find colorful leaves and learn all about the nature of a summer adventure.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: A test of the Shrinkinator goes comically wrong, leaving both Zak and Gramps completely invisible! Zak must embark on a desperate search for a vital part to reverse their new state, a task complicated by Chowser, who thinks he's being chased by Zak's ghost. Meanwhile, Adilla, realizing her aggressive nature is hindering her plans, forces Syd to become her etiquette coach, attempting to learn charm and diplomacy to better manipulate other insects.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Zak's bionic arm gets a new upgrade that can project a hologram of himself. After some initial pranks, he is forced to use the new tech to cleverly escape the clutches of some hungry spiders. His day of upgrades continues when one of Gramps's growth experiments actually works, making him slightly larger and stronger. His newfound size comes just in time, as he must use his enhanced strength to rescue Chowser from Hye and Lo.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The Insectibles are locked in a desperate race against Adilla and her roaches to secure a dangerous Shrinkinator lens before its destructive power can be unleashed on the yard. Following that crisis, Zak discovers one of Gramps's old jetpack prototypes. Seeing a chance to gain an advantage, he tries to fly it himself but soon realizes he needs help, forcing him to enlist the expert flyer Willow for a risky aerial mission to get another part.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: End your Adventurous August with a wild chase! Help Jeff and Fuse guard a precious treasure. Then, go on a mission with Pogo to follow a rival ice cream truck all the way to the snowy mountains to find its secret ingredient!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! First, the perfect snowy day inspires Pogo to pull some pranks, but they go too far and he and Newt come face-to-face with a hungry bear! Then, Jeff is throwing a party to impress some snooty friends, but his high expectations cause his waiter to quit, leaving him in a disaster. The trouble continues when Newt is asked to look after a mystery parcel and can't resist taking a peek inside!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join the Antiks on a series of chaotic adventures for delicious food! Whether it's a tantalizing lollipop, a rolling olive, or a crumb from a biscuit, Joey and Boo will do whatever it takes to get it. Their journey is filled with unexpected obstacles, from treacherous sticky tape to menacing fly swatters and even a mind-controlling mushroom. Through teamwork and clever thinking, these tiny heroes face every challenge head-on in a comical pursuit of their next meal.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. Then, they struggle to move a giant piece of candy until they eat some of it, giving them super speed! The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

programme.desc: Jin-kyeong, an emergency counselor from the suicide hotline, listens to the lamenting stories of suicidal people. However, one night, she picks up the call to hear her dead brother's voice on the line and Jin-kyeong is gripped with fear that she can't escape.

programme.title: The Eyes
programme.desc: The story begins after Trang, a famous artiste, awakens from coma following a horrific car accident. The traumatic injury leaves her with memory loss. She also has to undergo eye transplant surgery to regain her vision. But right after the surgery, Trang starts seeing a lady ghost with bloodshot eyes following her around. She decides to investigate the spooky encounters and discovers unimaginable secrets that her very own husband has been trying to hide from her.

programme.title: Nemesis
programme.desc: A former psychiatric patient seeks vengeance and aims to take down a gang of underworld criminals after a tragic accident sees his beloved family killed.

programme.title: The Flood
programme.desc: After a massive hurricane floods the streets of Louisiana, a group of in-transit prisoners and their guards seek shelter in a local police station. They did not expect the flood to bring a deadly horde of hungry giant alligators to their door. To survive this ordeal, prisoners and guards must work together to fight against the slithery monsters.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: Ron is a travelling salesman who is superstitious. Each time he stays in a new hotel room, he would perform all steps needed to avoid offending any spirits, such as knocking the door and politely greeting the room before entering it. He would also cover any mirror that faces the bed. Yet, when he returns from a late-night dinner, the room still feels eerily strange.

programme.title: The Spirit of Ramayana
programme.desc: In order to prove herself to her family, 24-year-old contemporary dancer Mintra auditions for a new play called "Ramayana", hoping to land her dream role Seeda. But the director deems her too nice for the role, which portrays contrasting sides of good and evil. Instead, her rival Gina is chosen for the role, awakening resentment in Mintra and prompting her to accept the offer of a female ghost to help bring out her dark side.

programme.title: Black Hand
programme.desc: Jung-woo is a highly successful neurosurgeon who works in a bioengineering research facility. He is married but is having a clandestine affair with one of the female doctors there named Yoo-gyeong. One day Yoo-gyeong has a muysterious accident and her hand is severed. But due to his quick action, Jung-woo is able to save her life and reattach her hand using a newly developed technology. The revolutionary surgery even improves Yoo-gyeong's health and she feels better than ever. But there are terrible side-effects as bizarre events begin to happen around her.

programme.title: Anguish
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Tess has suffered a pained past. She's been diagnosed with an assortment of mental ailments since her mother discovered her at a young age gruesomely banging her head against a wall. Now Tess's new medication seems to be working as she and her mother move to a new town seeking a fresh start. As Tess adjusts to her new life, horrific visions begin appearing of a deceased local girl, Lucy, recently killed in a grisly car accident. Hallucinations and physical manifestations intensify as Lucy's haunted spirit inhabits Tess's mind, body and soul. A local priest fears that it is Lucy attempting to return by taking control of the troubled Tess, and suggests exorcism as the only way to drive the dead girl out and bring peace to both of these tortured young souls.

programme.title: S3RAM (HD)

Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for some construction chaos and clever fixes! First, Mr. Rubble is very tired and puts the plans on the board upside down, causing the crew to build a house upside down! Then, while building a roundabout, the crew finds some big old dinosaur bones! The chaos continues as a power cut stops all their machines, so they hook everything up to clean solar panels instead. From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley, Dazey and the crew for a big day of rescues and learning! When the barn at Old MacDonald's Farm catches fire, the crew uses quick thinking to extinguish the flames. Then, a trip to the mountains goes wrong when an avalanche traps them in a tunnel, and they must find a clever way to escape! The rescues continue as Digley faces his fear of heights to restore a broken clock and the friends work together to save Scout after she falls down a hole during a thunderstorm.

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to laugh as everything goes hilariously wrong for Kii and Yii and their friends! The chaos starts when Robot creates a jelly-making machine, but it goes haywire and he ends up stuck inside a giant wobbly jelly! Then, Princess Cat puts way too much soap in her washing machine, causing it to overflow and fill her entire castle with bubbles! From a wobbly tooth to a picky eater, it's one funny problem after another!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate teamwork and rescue special with Kii and Yii! The adventure begins when Princess Cat is flying her plane but gets in a sticky jammy mess, causing her to lose control! It's up to Kii and Yii to get her down safely. Then, the friends are playing near Princess Cat's castle when she accidentally falls down the well and needs to be rescued again! From helping Humpty Dumpty to rounding up runaway vegetables, Kii and Yii always save the day!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join an Artsy August of performance! Teach Lola the cow some ballet moves and put on a show for the whole farm. Then, create your own sock puppet show, design a mini-golf course, and learn about all the different jobs in the community!

programme.desc: It's makeover time for Artsy August! Give Mom a wild new look with crazy makeup and pink hair. Then, fix your friends' broken items with crafts on the bus, hunt for treasure as a mermaid, and play detective to find a missing bunny!

programme.title: Little Angel

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get crafty for Artsy August! Dig into Baby John's craft box and make a whole family of finger puppets. Then, play a fun color-matching game with a new train, count magical potatoes, and have a bubbly, colorful bath time adventure!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Invent some wild treats this Artsy August! Help Baby John use his new ice cream machine, but watch out for the yucky flavors! Then, decorate Bingo's cone, play Cookie Police to solve a mystery, and see who wins a race at the playground!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: It's time to play at home with Baby John and the family! First, they get everything ready for a fun movie night in the backyard, complete with popcorn and a projector. Then, the kids make a crazy bubble machine that makes bubbles of all sizes and colors, but it gets a little out of control! The fun at home continues as the kids plan a surprise romantic dinner for Mom and Dad and create a sock puppet show!

programme.desc: Join JJ for a nature walk and some of his favorite rhymes! First, JJ's family shows him all the fun things we can do to help the Earth, like sorting trash for recycling. Sing along as ten animal friends try to share a bed and help the three little kittens who have lost their mittens!

programme.desc: Join Cody as he learns how to be a good brother and a good friend! In a heartwarming moment, Cody finds out he's going to be a big brother. After some initial nerves, he spends a special day with his mama and her baby bump. Then, the big day arrives as the family brings his new sister, Kendi, home! Watch Cody take on his new role, helping Kendi get to sleep and learning to play new games together like bouncing a balloon.

Sing along as JJ learns to use the potty and TomTom learns what happens when you lose a tooth. Plus, join the Melon Patch kids as they visit the doctor for a checkup and learn that it's nothing to be afraid of!

The party continues as they play the 'Who Took the Cookie?' game and march along to 'John Jacob Jingleheimer Schmidt.' It's a dance party full of timeless, interactive fun!

Then, it's all stations go as Buster dreams he's a space rocket and blasts off to tour all the planets! The dreams continue as he becomes Sheriff Buster in the wild west and finds a magic spell book that causes all sorts of trouble!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as he learns how to be a good friend! When a new, shy student named Ash the firetruck joins the school, Buster sees he's all alone and invites him to play. Then, Buster learns another important lesson when he starts to lose a game of snakes and ladders and decides to cheat. From learning that sports aren't all about winning to standing up for his friends during a sleepover, Buster is on his way to being the best friend ever!

The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: ARPO

JJ's family gives Bingo a scrub in the tub after he gets dirty playing outside, and all the kids chip in to wash a filthy firetruck. It's fun to make a mess, and even more fun to clean up!

programme.title: Dance Party

Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!
